messages:
Anya: Proposal: run a 2-week pilot for followup closure velocity. TL;DR: small template + 15m weekly huddle + bot digest + 72h remediation-assignment rule. Can we start next Monday?
Sam: sounds useful. keep tooling minimal please. I can wire a JQL and bot digest.
Jordan: agree. last time IC and remediation owner overlap caused ambiguity. suggest explicit 'remediation_owner' field.
Anya: yep, template (tiny):
```
- action_id: AF-100
- remediation_owner: @Sam
- created_by: @Anya
- created_ts: 2026-04-01
- due_date: 2026-04-08
- priority: P2
- status: open / blocked / done
- validation: 7d post-deploy error rate < 0.1%
- recurrence_flag: true/false
- linked_ticket: https://rwd/jira/AF-100
- notes: one-line blocker
```
Lee: add "validation_window" (e.g. 7d) and a lightweight "relationship" tag (SLO/billing/customer).
Maria: I'll schedule a 15-min closure huddle Mon 11am to triage blockers. Suggest owners only. Keeps it short.
Sam: I'll create saved JQL: `project = AF AND status != Done AND due_date < now()` and hook a weekly digest to #eng-oncall.
Jordan: Metrics to track during pilot: closure_velocity (actions_closed/week), median_time_to_close, percent_recurrence. I'll make a dashboard.
Anya: Policy ask: remediation_owner must be claimed within 72h of postmortem publish, otherwise auto-escalate to oncall lead. That avoids latelapse ownership.
Sam: automation plan: incident-bot creates followup tasks from postmortem items, sets owner if present, otherwise marks unassigned and pings #eng-oncall. low effort.
incident-bot: Heads-up: 2 followups older than 14 days (AF-088, AF-091).
Lee: For prioritization, add a quick score: (priority + recurrence + SLO impact) => triage rank. keeps queue ordered.
Maria: I've booked Mon 11am for two weeks. Calendar invites sent to owners when actions are assigned.
Jordan: I'll populate a starter dashboard and share link here by Friday.
Sam: I'll post the bot config and saved JQL tomorrow.
Anya: Pilot owners: Sam (automation), Jordan (metrics/dashboard), Maria (huddle). I'll handle the 72h escalation enforcement. Start date: 2026-04-06, review 2026-04-20.
Lee: Small habit: when closing an action, add a 1-line "how verified" sentence. avoids fuzzy closures.
Sam: ack. Also will add a weekly overdue digest and a single message when action is past due >7d.
Jordan: If recurrence_flag true, tag incident postmortem and run a 30-day pattern review.
Anya: end state: faster closure, clearer owners, and catch recurring signals earlier. Thanks team — I'll post the final template and docs in #eng-oncall after updates.
Maria: :white_check_mark:
Lee: :thumbsup:
Sam: :rocket:
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: followup pilot starts 2026-04-06.
Anya: closing thread; will reopen with templates/links.
